style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, deep rich colors, dark background with the main figures brightly lit, a faint washi-paper texture. Archaic ancient Greek clothing.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern buildings or clothes, Roman armor, comic-book costumes, nudity, blood, a square wooden box

epimetheus.desc_en: Epimetheus, a Titan of Greek myth, a gentle good-natured young man about 25 with soft wavy chestnut-brown hair to the jaw, a short light beard, wide honest eyes and a slightly absent-minded look, Archaic Greek clothing: a knee-length undyed off-white wool chiton belted with a cord, a faded olive-green himation cloak over one shoulder, leather sandals, no armor, no crown

pandora.desc_en: Pandora, the first woman of Greek myth, a young woman about 20 with long dark-brown hair partly tied up with a thin gold band, large curious eyes, Archaic Greek clothing: a long ivory peplos dress with a woven border of small red and dark-blue patterns, a fine pale veil on her shoulders, gold earrings and a thin golden crown of leaves

prometheus.desc_en: Prometheus, a Titan of Greek myth, the elder brother, a lean sharp-eyed man about 35 with short dark-brown hair, a neat dark beard, a keen serious face, Archaic Greek clothing: a knee-length dark-blue wool chiton with a plain cloak, leather sandals, no armor

cuts.image: 左右に分けた比べる絵。左半分：冷たい青い光の中、鋭い目の兄が人さし指を立てて、真剣な顔で強く止めている上半身。右半分：暖かい金色の光の中、人のよい弟が両腕を広げてにこにこ笑い、その背後に大きな素焼きの甕から黒いもやが立ちのぼる。2人とも画面の上下の真ん中の高さに大きく描き、上の4分の1と下の4分の1は暗い空と暗い床だけ
cuts.image_en: A split comparison picture. Left half: in cold blue light, the sharp-eyed elder brother raises his index finger with a stern, serious face, warning strongly, upper body. Right half: in warm golden light, the good-natured younger brother opens both arms with a big happy smile, while behind him black mist rises ominously out of a large earthenware storage jar. Both are drawn large at the vertical middle of the picture; the top quarter and the bottom quarter show only dark sky and dark floor with nothing in them.

cuts.image: 夕暮れの家の戸口で、人のよい若い男が両腕を広げて、にこにこ笑ってこちらを見る上半身。その肩ごしの暗い部屋の奥で、金の冠の女が大きな素焼きの甕のふたを開け、黒いもやと影の群れがあふれ出している。男は気づいていない。上下の4分の1は暗い空と暗い床だけ
cuts.image_en: At the doorway of a house at dusk, a good-natured young man opens both arms and smiles happily at the viewer, upper body. Over his shoulder, deep in the dark room behind him, a woman in a golden crown lifts the lid of a large earthenware storage jar and black mist and swarms of shadows pour out. The man has not noticed. He is drawn large at the vertical middle of the picture; the top quarter and the bottom quarter show only dark sky and dark floor with nothing in them.
